question: The recently released book "Madam Sir" narrates the story of which of the following woman IPS officers?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manjari Jaruhar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Manjari Jaruhar:** The recently released book **"Madam Sir"** narrates the story of Manjari Jaruhar.

 
 
• Manjari Jaruhar is noted as the **first woman IPS officer of the Indian state of Bihar.**
